title: CaseGraphen MCP host: compile_deployment_bundle payload
description: The literal `payload.compiler_request` an MCP client sends for the `compile_deployment_bundle` tool. It is the wire request, not the retained record the compiler later writes into the deployment bundle (casegraphen.experimental.graph_compiler.inputs.v1) — that record adds compiler identity, contract versions, and a mode discriminant this payload does not carry.
